newsitem.title: CHINA: China Interbank Market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China Interbank Market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said trading was slow, with short-term financial centres continuing to buy on the market.
"Trading levels did not change today and rates will move in narrow ranges in the next few days," one local trader said.

Traders said the good fundamentals of the domestic economy will push rates down in the mid term, with some expecting that a fall in domestic inflation will make the central bank cut interest rates again early next year.
